title: Apple Introduces iMac Featuring the M6 Chip
excerpt: Apple has announced its new iMac powered by the M6 processor, focusing on significantly improved artificial intelligence performance.
body_html:
Apple has announced the release of its new iMac equipped with the M6 processor. According to the company, this latest model delivers a substantial advancement in artificial intelligence capabilities compared to previous hardware.

The new iteration features an increased number of processing cores alongside higher performance metrics per individual core relative to the preceding iMac M5 generation.
